title: Coconut Chicken & Rice
subtitle: with red bell pepper, spinach, & fresh coriander
description: This vibrant & creamy curry is made from tender pieces of chicken smothered in a thick coconut curry sauce consisting of red onions & peppers, ginger, tomato and fresh chilli. Balanced out with earthy spinach & fragrant coriander. All served with a generous helping of brown rice. What are you waiting for, Chef? Curry up and get cooking!

instructions.title: NICE RICE BABY
instructions.text: Rinse the rice and place in a pot over medium-high heat. Submerge in 500ml of salted water and pop on the lid. Once boiling, reduce the heat and simmer for 25-30 minutes until most of the water has been absorbed. Keeping the lid on, remove from the heat and steam for 10 minutes. Drain if necessary and fluff up with a fork.

instructions.title: GOLDEN CHICKY CHUNKS
instructions.text: Place a deep pan or pot over medium-high heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, add the chicken chunks and fry for 1-2 minutes until browned but not cooked through, shifting as it colours. Remove from the pan and set aside.

instructions.title: AWESOME AROMATICS
instructions.text: Return the pan or pot to a medium heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, add the sliced onion, the sliced pepper, and the diced tomato. Fry for 6-7 minutes until soft, shifting occasionally. Add the grated ginger, 1/2 the sliced chilli (to taste), and the rub. Fry for 1-2 minutes until fragrant, shifting constantly.

instructions.title: CREAMY CURRY
instructions.text: When the chilli is fragrant, pour the coconut cream into the pot or pan. Simmer for 5-6 minutes until slightly thickened. In the final 1-2 minutes, add the browned chicken. Remove from the heat, stir through the rinsed spinach, 1/2 the picked coriander, a squeeze of lemon juice (to taste), a sweetener of choice (to taste), and seasoning. Loosen with a splash of warm water if it's too thick for your liking.

instructions.title: PLATE IT UP!
instructions.text: Dish up the rice and the fragrant coconut chicken. Garnish with the remaining coriander and chilli (to taste). Serve with any remaining lemon wedges. Indulge your senses, Chef!
